title: DynaVelo neural ODE model predicts rescue perturbations in germinal center B cells
summary: DynaVelo, a generative neural ordinary differential equation model, learns joint dynamics of gene expression and transcription factor motif activity from single-cell multiome data and allows in silico perturbation. It recovered murine germinal center B cell dynamics under heterozygous loss of Arid1a and Ctcf and identified Ctcf, Stat3 and Bcl6 as rescue targets for Arid1a loss. In vivo experiments in double-heterozygous mice confirmed rescue of the Arid1aHet dark-zone phenotype for all three, and multiome profiling of Arid1aHet;CtcfHet germinal centers validated the predicted shift toward wild-type dynamics. The work is in mouse germinal center B cells.
ai_technology: Generative neural ordinary differential equation model of single-cell multiomic dynamics with in silico perturbation

evidence.tested: In vivo double-heterozygous mouse experiments and multiome profiling tested the predicted rescue targets.
evidence.unknown: Applicability beyond mouse germinal center B cells; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: DynaVelo predicted loss-of-function and rescue perturbations in silico.
